package.name: threevn_perception
package.description:
Finding things in camera images.
The detection itself is pure functions over numpy arrays: no ROS, no simulator, no camera. That split is the point. Image processing that can only be exercised by starting Gazebo and waiting for a frame is image processing nobody tests, and perception is exactly where a wrong sign or a swapped axis produces output that looks reasonable and is wrong.
ARCHITECTURAL RULE: like threevn_control and threevn_bringup, this package must never depend on Gazebo. It consumes sensor_msgs, which a real camera and a simulated one both publish.
